items.stem: You need to pick a vector store. What should drive the choice?

options.text: Documented requirements: scale, latency, filtering, operations and cost
options.rationale: Correct: requirements-driven selection fits the store to the workload.

options.text: Whichever store is most talked about online
The one with the most features regardless of need
options.rationale: Unneeded features add cost and complexity.

options.text: Whatever the AI tool suggests first
options.rationale: An unexamined suggestion is not a basis for selection.

items.explanation: Correct: requirements-driven selection fits the store to the workload.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO statements about approximate nearest-neighbour (ANN) indexes are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: ANN trades some recall for much lower latency and can be tuned
options.rationale: Correct: ANN parameters control the recall/latency trade-off.

options.text: Metadata filters can scope ANN searches to a subset
options.rationale: Correct: filtering restricts results to matching metadata.

options.text: ANN always returns the exact true nearest neighbours
Tuning ANN parameters has no effect on recall
options.rationale: Parameters directly affect recall and latency.

items.explanation: Correct: ANN parameters control the recall/latency trade-off.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: After deleting many documents, stale results still appear. What is the likely cause?

options.text: The index needs reindexing or compaction for deletes to fully take effect
options.rationale: Correct: deletes often require reindexing/compaction to be reflected.

options.text: The embedding model changed on its own
options.rationale: Models do not change by themselves.

options.text: Deletes always apply instantly with no maintenance
options.rationale: That assumption is what causes the stale results.

items.explanation: Correct: deletes often require reindexing/compaction to be reflected.
